context.transcript:
Good morning, Ms. Lee.
This is Clyde Anderson from Business Global Magazine.
I'm writing an article on waste reduction programs, and I understand your company has made significant achievements in that regard at your manufacturing plants.
That's right.
There are programs in place at our food plants in both Shanghai and Mexico City.
We've reduced the amount of packaging waste by 40% in the last year.
That's quite impressive.
Will you be implementing the same program in the United States soon?
Well, we'd like to.
It might be hard to do at our California-based plant, though.
There are a lot of regulations to consider.
context.transcript_translation:
李女士，早上好。
我是来自 Business Global Magazine 的 Clyde Anderson。
我正在撰写一篇关于废物减少计划的文章，我知道贵公司在制造工厂方面在这方面取得了显著成就。
是的。
我们在上海和墨西哥城两地的食品厂都有实施的计划。
去年我们将包装废料减少了 40%。
这相当令人印象深刻。
您是否很快会在美国也实施同样的计划？
嗯，我们希望如此。
不过，在我们的加州工厂可能很难做到。
有很多规定需要考虑。
